gen-gf-unica-one-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Big-eyed and stern, Unica One draws every stroke at a single thickness with daylight inside each curve. And BhuTuka Expanded One, a classic serif, slows the pace to a leisurely walk with curvy, unclamped letters.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab reads stretched-out and bookish, its open counters breathing into the white space with no thick-thin shifts. Unica One above it stays loud and tall, so the lines beneath feel unhurried.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-kiwi-maru: Editorial through and through, Kiwi Maru spaces its letters generously, with terminals stopping well short of the stem. But Unica One, drawn at one thickness with a very large lowercase eye, is what gives the pair its commanding edge.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-padyakke-expanded-on: Tall, stark and wide-eyed up top, then something far looser below. Padyakke Expanded One spreads its glyphs like knots on a slack rope, so giving it a little extra size would help it hold its own against Unica One.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Unica One brings a commanding, daylight-filled lowercase over Stint Ultra Expanded, whose characters float apart from one another. Give the body a touch more size so those wide letters hold together.
gen-gf-unifrakturcook-fs-rowan: Dense, dark and ceremonial up top. If UnifrakturCook gets made small, its packed lines turn tight and hard to open, while Rowan stays friendly, with generous curves and thin strokes about half the weight of its thick ones.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab reads tall and rounded, with a c that gapes at any size. Unkempt is best at expressive, monoline shouting, while the body font is best at quietly carrying dignified lines.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-glegoo: Rough-hewn headline, refined text underneath. Glegoo has big counters in a tall lowercase and open curves, and its editorial polish is what makes Unkempt's tubing-like stems look deliberate.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-hanuman: Unkempt skims along at a constant stroke weight, crossbar matching stem. Hanuman, a serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, gives that loose energy a traditional, refined footing.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-kadwa: A crossbar as heavy as its stem gives Unkempt its scrappy, monoline swagger. That makes it best for announcing things, while Kadwa, a text serif with open-ended curves and a large x-height, is best for settling in and reading on.
